parts.label: Hydraulic tappet body
parts.description: Contains the internal oil reservoir, oil inlet and guiding bore.

parts.label: Plunger return spring
parts.description: Biases the plunger outward during clearance compensation.

parts.label: Check-valve housing
parts.description: Carries the check plate and its spring.

parts.label: Check-valve spring
parts.description: Illustrative spring bias at the internal check valve.

parts.label: Check-valve plate
parts.description: Closes to trap oil under load; opens to allow replenishment.

parts.label: Hydraulic plunger
parts.description: Hollow plunger provides a reservoir and transmits force through trapped oil.

parts.label: Pushrod socket
parts.description: Receives the pushrod end and provides an oil discharge passage.

parts.label: Retaining ring
parts.description: Retains the plunger/socket assembly inside the body.

reference: GTSIO-520 reviewed manual, Figure A-4-10, printed A-4-7, items 1-16. Geometry and travel illustrative.
scope: Manual-based mechanism teaching study. All dimensions and operating travel are illustrative; not a maintenance procedure or pressure simulation.

stages.label: Unloaded
stages.note: Plunger extended; replenishment travel is illustrative.

stages.label: Loading
stages.note: The body and internals rise together; the check plate stays closed during loading.

stages.label: Trapped oil under load
stages.note: The closed check valve retains oil as the load is transmitted.

stages.label: Replenishing
stages.note: During return, the plunger extends and the check plate opens for illustrative replenishment.

stages.label: Cycle returns
stages.note: The illustration returns to its initial pose.

stages.label: Retainer and socket
stages.note: Locate the retaining ring and pushrod socket.

stages.note: Locate the oil reservoir and plunger return spring.

stages.note: Follow the check-valve housing, plate and spring.
